title: RISE Live: the light room (Porcelain, opt-in)
acceptance: Porcelain is a fifth face in Settings (Sophia stays the default). Choosing it makes the room light at once: a warm porcelain ground, navy ink for words, a cobalt face drawn as glaze and ink; choosing a dark face, or leaving, returns the room to dark and leaves no mark on the page.

The reading wears the room: its ground, words and figures are the room's whatever the answer's theme, and the stage, the bar and the Settings sheet are a pale glass. The smallest text is at least 4.5:1 on the ground (WCAG AA).

Lit window: a visual made of light keeps a night of its own (Porcelain's deep). In the inner eye and the shell it shows through the aperture with a crisp rim; in the full frame it is hung as a rounded picture in the safe rectangle, at most square on a tall screen, never laid over the room. A figure is drawn on the room in ink, its dark parts deep navy, with nothing night behind it.
The face's trail returns to exactly the pale ground (no tinted residue), proven against Chromium's own 8-bit blend.
The dark room and the card are unchanged: every glass colour falls back to its old value, and the light room's rules apply only under the root's data-live-room.
